article.story: AMHERST, Mass. -- — Javontae Campbell scored 47 points, and Mayar Wol added five in overtime as Bowling Green beat UMass 101-100 on Saturday. Campbell had six rebounds and eight assists for the Falcons (11-4, 2-1 Mid-American Conference). Wol scored 21 points while going 8 of 14 (3 for 6 from 3-point range) and added six rebounds and three steals. Leonardo Bettiol finished with 32 points and 14 rebounds for the Minutemen (9-6, 0-3). K'Jei Parker added 21 points and four assists for UMass. Daniel Hankins-Sanford finished with 14 points and six rebounds. Campbell led Bowling Green with 26 second-half points as the teams ended regulation tied 86-86. Wol scored five overtime points while finishing 2 of 3 from the floor. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
